h2. Summary

Multiple filter functionality issues were identified in the Local Workers List screen, affecting user experience and data filtering capabilities.

h2. Description

Four distinct issues were identified with the filter functionality in the Local Workers List screen:

h3. Issue 1: Unable to Unselect Filter Options

Users cannot directly unselect options from the 氏名 (Name) and 氏名（カナ) (Name in Kana) filters once selected. This prevents users from easily removing filter criteria without refreshing the page. *Expected Behavior*: Users should be able to unselect filter options directly from the dropdown. *Actual Behavior*: No mechanism exists to unselect options once they are selected.

h3. Issue 2: Label Inconsistency

There is a discrepancy between the filter label and the table column header for the Name in Kana field. 
*Expected Behavior*: Consistent naming should be used across the interface. 
*Actual Behavior*: The filter uses 氏名（カナ) while the table column header uses 氏名カナ.

h3. Issue 3: Duplicate Data in Filter

The 氏名（カナ) (Name in Kana) filter contains duplicate entries for the same person. 
*Expected Behavior*: Each name should appear only once in the filter dropdown. 
*Actual Behavior*: The name "小林 正夫" appears twice in the dropdown list.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as a Client user
# Navigate to [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/client/attendance-approval/work-experience/index.html?targetYear=2025&targetMonth=7+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/client/attendance-approval/work-experience/index.html?targetYear=2025&targetMonth=7]
# For Issue 1:
#* Click on the 氏名 or 氏名（カナ) filter dropdown
#* Select any option
#* Attempt to unselect/clear the selection
# For Issue 2:
#* Compare the label of the filter 氏名（カナ) with the table column header 氏名カナ
# For Issue 3:
#* Open the 氏名（カナ) filter dropdown
#* Look for the name "小林 正夫" which appears twice

h2. Expected Results

# Users should be able to unselect filter options directly
# Labels should be consistent between filters and table headers
# Each name should appear only once in filter dropdowns
# All filters should correspond to visible data columns in the table

h2. Actual Results

# No mechanism to unselect filter options
# Inconsistent labeling between filter (氏名（カナ)) and table header (氏名カナ)
# Duplicate entry for "小林 正夫" in the 氏名（カナ) filter

h2. Screenshots

[https://www.loom.com/share/3a4109c4c60a49d0a252298dde6a9fb8?sid=954fe060-e2fb-4d49-b127-cb0420d737f1|https://www.loom.com/share/3a4109c4c60a49d0a252298dde6a9fb8?sid=954fe060-e2fb-4d49-b127-cb0420d737f1|smart-embed]

h2. Summary

When a user without proper permissions attempts to logout from the attendance approval application page, they are incorrectly redirected to a 404 error page instead of being properly logged out and redirected to the login screen.

h2. Preconditions

# User has an account in the system
# User does not have the required permissions for attendance approval
# User is logged in to the system

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Login to the system with credentials that don't have attendance approval permissions
# Navigate to or directly access the URL: [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/client/attendance-approval/application/index.html?applicationType=attendance_change_application&approvalStatus=pending+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/client/attendance-approval/application/index.html?applicationType=attendance_change_application&approvalStatus=pending]
# Locate and click on the logout button/link

h2. Actual Result

User is redirected to a 404 error page instead of being logged out properly.

h2. Expected Result

User should be successfully logged out and redirected to the login screen as specified in the logout use case:

# The system should delete the user's session
# The system should redirect the user to the login screen

h2. Attachments

[https://www.loom.com/share/b33c0f98575a47aebe04cf8adfbd84a0?sid=6c993354-727d-4ce3-b72d-af05e392154c|https://www.loom.com/share/b33c0f98575a47aebe04cf8adfbd84a0?sid=6c993354-727d-4ce3-b72d-af05e392154c|smart-embed]
items.toString:
h2. Summary

When a user without proper permissions attempts to logout from the attendance approval application page, they are incorrectly redirected to a 404 error page instead of being properly logged out and redirected to the login screen.

h2. Preconditions

# User has an account in the system as a staff
# User is logged in to the system on Android / iOS

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Login to the system with credentials
# Access the URL: [https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/staff/?month=7&year=2025|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/staff/?month=7&year=2025]
# Locate and click on the logout button/link

h2. Actual Result

User is redirected to a 404 error page instead of being logged out properly.

h2. Expected Result

User should be successfully logged out and redirected to the login screen as specified in the logout use case.

h2. Attachments

!WhatsApp Video 2025-07-17 at 19.15.24.mp4|width=384,height=848,alt="WhatsApp Video 2025-07-17 at 19.15.24.mp4"!

items.fromString:
h2. Summary

Staff users are unable to clock in when using the YUIME StaffCore application on Android and iOS mobile devices. When attempting to clock in, users receive an error toast message stating "Failed to register start time, please reload the page."

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Log in to the YUIME StaffCore system as a Staff user on an Android or iOS device
# Navigate to the Attendance Application Screen
# Tap the "Clock in" (出勤) button
# Observe the error toast message

h2. Actual Result

When tapping the "Clock in" button, a toast message appears stating: "Failed to register start time, please reload the page" and the clock-in action fails to complete.

h2. Expected Result

The system should acquire the current time and register it in the database as "Work start time." After successful processing:

* The "Clock in" button should change to "Clock out" (退勤)
* The "Start break" (休憩開始) button should become selectable
* A success toast message should appear: "Work start time has been recorded" (「勤務開始時間を打刻しました」)

h2. Attachment

!REC-20250715224906.mp4|width=483,height=1080,alt="REC-20250715224906.mp4"!

* The "Clock in" button should change to "Clock out" (退勤)

h2. Description

When users open the attendance list page and scroll down the menu on iOS devices, the text in the attendance table overlaps with the table borders. This creates readability issues and affects the user experience.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/staff/+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/staff/]
# Log in with valid credentials
# Open the attendance list section
# Scroll down through the attendance records

h2. Expected Behavior

The text in the attendance table should be properly contained within its cells with appropriate spacing from borders.

h2. Actual Behavior

The text "attendanceCl..." overlaps with the table borders, creating a visual issue as seen in the screenshot.

h2. Visual Evidence

!image-20250715-151536.png|width=380,height=829,alt="image-20250715-151536.png"!

items.fromString:
h2. Issues

h3. Issue 1: User without edit permission can assign staff to opportunity

According to the use case documentation ([https://studio.jitera.app/projects/yuime-staffcore-develop_version2-227d9b37-2243-409c-bca2-578deb1e11c7-eebf30/docs/0887a458-bd02-4049-a317-b78ea3b4d581|https://studio.jitera.app/projects/yuime-staffcore-develop_version2-227d9b37-2243-409c-bca2-578deb1e11c7-eebf30/docs/0887a458-bd02-4049-a317-b78ea3b4d581]), only users with editing permissions for the Assignment Management screen should be able to assign Staff/Assign Workers to opportunities. However, users without these permissions are currently able to perform staff assignments.

h4. Steps to Reproduce (Issue 1)

# Log in as a user without edit permissions for the Assignment Management screen
# Navigate to the Assignment Management screen
# Select an opportunity
# Attempt to assign a staff member to the opportunity
# Observe that the system allows the assignment to be completed

h4. Expected Behavior (Issue 1)

Users without edit permissions for the Assignment Management screen should not be able to assign staff to opportunities. The system should block this action and display an appropriate error message.

h4. Actual Behavior (Issue 1)

Users without edit permissions can successfully assign staff to opportunities without any restrictions.

[https://www.loom.com/share/f82a57a72e5a44dea153693607d800b8?sid=0b6cc1f0-db3b-4dad-82ab-168c9c813dc0|https://www.loom.com/share/f82a57a72e5a44dea153693607d800b8?sid=0b6cc1f0-db3b-4dad-82ab-168c9c813dc0|smart-embed]

h3.  

Issue 2: User can assign staff to opportunity with overlapping date conditions

The system is allowing users to assign staff to opportunities with overlapping operational periods, which violates the business rules defined in the use case.

h4. Steps to Reproduce (Issue 2)

# Log in to the system with a user that has edit permissions
# Navigate to the staff assignment page at the URL provided
# Select a staff member who is already assigned to an opportunity with a specific operational period
# Attempt to assign the same staff member to another opportunity with an overlapping operational period
# Observe that the system allows the assignment to be completed

h4. Expected Behavior (Issue 2)

The system should prevent staff from being assigned to opportunities with overlapping operational periods. When attempting such an assignment, the system should display an error message indicating that the staff member is already assigned during that time period.

h4. Actual Behavior (Issue 2)

The system allows staff to be assigned to multiple opportunities with overlapping operational periods without any validation or warning.

[https://www.loom.com/share/1340844fad384367aa3edf01584109c5?sid=04f66895-e6cc-444b-83d5-e735ff0ba98f|https://www.loom.com/share/1340844fad384367aa3edf01584109c5?sid=04f66895-e6cc-444b-83d5-e735ff0ba98f|smart-embed]

*Summary :* 

User cannot see value Cost Allocation Details (費用負担詳細) on modal after edit transition expenses

*Step to repro :* 

# Go to [https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/opportunity-detail/?opportunityId=9db44ca8-e6b5-4c3e-a70f-a01dbc77db39&transitionWorkerId=0428d436-2333-4826-bfca-2b2db1782d75&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/opportunity-detail/?opportunityId=9db44ca8-e6b5-4c3e-a70f-a01dbc77db39&transitionWorkerId=0428d436-2333-4826-bfca-2b2db1782d75&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem]
# Add transition expenses
# Click Cost Allocation (費用負担) and choose other
# Input text on Cost Allocation Details (費用負担詳細)
# Submit transition expenses
# Submit edit transition
# Click edit on the transition expenses
# Observe the vaue of Cost Allocation Details (費用負担詳細)

*Existing Result :* 

The text is Cost Allocation Details (費用負担詳細) removed on the modal edit but display on the transition expenses list

*Expected Result :* 

The Cost Allocation Details (費用負担詳細) should still visible

items.fromString:
h2. Bug Description

When a user cancels a staff member's leave status on the staff detail page, the leave information record is still displayed in the details panel. According to the requirements, the canceled leave information record should be deleted and not displayed in the details panel.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to the staff detail page: [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/staff/detail/?id=19b8606b-e464-4752-bb7f-818ce789f625&listtab=leave&tab=leave+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/staff/detail/?id=19b8606b-e464-4752-bb7f-818ce789f625&listtab=leave&tab=leave]
# Select the "Leave" tab
# Hover over a leave record row that can be canceled
# Click the cancel button
# Confirm the cancellation in the dialog
# Observe that the leave information record is still displayed in the details panel

h2. Expected Behavior

According to the use case documentation:

* The canceled leave information record should be deleted and not displayed in the details panel.

h2. Actual Behavior

* The leave information record is still displayed in the details panel after cancellation.
* The toast message may appear correctly, but the record is not removed from the UI.
* This issue also happens on *Canceled Retirement*

h2. Attachment

[https://www.loom.com/share/db4565df7d9d42739e665d6cbca16612?sid=d09f2bc6-aefd-4046-8ce2-13a127cdf6fd|https://www.loom.com/share/db4565df7d9d42739e665d6cbca16612?sid=d09f2bc6-aefd-4046-8ce2-13a127cdf6fd|smart-embed]

# Observe that the leave information record is still displayed in the details panel

h2. Expected Behavior

According to the use case documentation:

* The canceled leave information record should be deleted and not displayed in the details panel.

h2. Actual Behavior

* The leave information record is still displayed in the details panel after cancellation.
* The toast message may appear correctly, but the record is not removed from the UI.
* This issue also happens on *Canceled Retirement*

h2. Attachment

[https://www.loom.com/share/db4565df7d9d42739e665d6cbca16612?sid=d09f2bc6-aefd-4046-8ce2-13a127cdf6fd|https://www.loom.com/share/db4565df7d9d42739e665d6cbca16612?sid=d09f2bc6-aefd-4046-8ce2-13a127cdf6fd|smart-embed]



h2. Issue 2: Retirement
Bug Description

When a user cancels a staff member's retirement on the staff detail page, the retirement information is still displayed in the details panel. According to the use case requirements, "The canceled retirement information should be deleted and not displayed in the details panel."

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to the staff detail page for a staff member with retirement information
# Go to the "Retirement" tab
# Click the "Cancel Retirement" button (退職を取消)
# Confirm the cancellation in the dialog
# Observe that the retirement information is still displayed in the details panel

h2. Current Behavior

After cancellation, the retirement information is still visible in the details panel.

h2. Expected Behavior

According to the use case document: "The canceled retirement information should be deleted and not displayed in the details panel.”

[https://www.loom.com/share/c49225a97cfd4f29add596728810e011?sid=d4bbb637-c8cd-425f-9ef0-687a7f7126a9|https://www.loom.com/share/c49225a97cfd4f29add596728810e011?sid=d4bbb637-c8cd-425f-9ef0-687a7f7126a9|smart-embed]

*Summary :* 

User with view permission "moverManagementPermission": 1 able to click upload document on transition detail

*Pre condition :* 
User with only view permission, in this case i edit the "moverManagementPermission": 1

*Step to repro :* 

# Go to [https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/opportunity/transition-info/?opportunityId=4dca3bd6-de35-4cf0-9a25-182fc27109fe&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/opportunity/transition-info/?opportunityId=4dca3bd6-de35-4cf0-9a25-182fc27109fe&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem]
# Click one of the list
# Observe the open transition detail
# Click on upload document

*Exsisting Result :* 

As you can see user can click and upload file

[https://www.loom.com/share/5021c5c5dfce44d79c038ee693cecd4e?sid=746d2fc9-0ab9-443b-9f8f-d707be138d5f|https://www.loom.com/share/5021c5c5dfce44d79c038ee693cecd4e?sid=746d2fc9-0ab9-443b-9f8f-d707be138d5f|smart-link] 

*Expected Result :* 

Since on the UC is not mentioned about this one, its good to improve this button *to be disable* like the other button on the Open Transition Details from Opportunity Tab, since the user only has view permission

h2. Summary

When users execute sorting filter for 年齢 (Age) on the opportunity detail page, the age values are not sorted properly in ascending order.
Description

When a user attempts to sort the staff/assign worker list by age (年齢) in ascending order on the opportunity detail page, the age values are not displayed in the correct numerical sequence. The sorting functionality appears to be treating age as a string rather than a numeric value, resulting in incorrect ordering.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to the opportunity detail page at [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/assignment/opportunity-detail/index.html?id=295aa4de-fb9e-4d20-a23d-029aae3ce402+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/assignment/opportunity-detail/index.html?id=295aa4de-fb9e-4d20-a23d-029aae3ce402]
# Click on the 年齢 (Age) column header to sort by age
# Notice that the age values are not sorted in proper numerical order

h2. Expected Behavior

When sorting by age in ascending order, the staff/assign workers should be displayed with age values in proper numerical sequence from lowest to highest (e.g., 21, 22, 23, 24...).

h2. Actual Behavior

The age values are not sorted in proper numerical order. For example, the sequence might appear as 1, 10, 11, 2, 20, 21, 3, etc., indicating that the system is sorting the age values as strings rather than numbers.

items.fromString:
h2. Description

During testing of the Transition Cost (移行費用) form in the Transition Information Registration functionality, multiple validation issues were identified. The form fails to properly validate required fields and does not provide appropriate user feedback when validation errors occur.

h2. Issues Breakdown

h3. Issue 1

*Problem*: If the user enters a value in キャンセル料 (cancellation fee) but leaves 決済額 (payment amount) empty. 
*Expected Behavior*: The system should validate that if キャンセル料 has a value, 決済額 should not be empty. 
*Actual Behavior*: No validation occurs for this relationship between fields.

h3. Issue 2

*Problem*: No error validation message is displayed if the user enters a value in キャンセル料 (cancellation fee) but leaves 決済額 (payment amount) empty. 
*Expected Behavior*: The system should display an error message: "Please enter the amount in half-width numbers" (金額は半角数字で入力してください). 
*Actual Behavior*: No error message is displayed for the empty 決済額 field.

h3. Issue 3

*Problem*: If the user selects 費用負担 (Cost Allocation) as "その他 (Other)" but leaves 費用負担詳細 (Cost Allocation Details) empty. 
*Expected Behavior*: The system should validate that if 費用負担 is "その他", 費用負担詳細 should not be empty. 
*Actual Behavior*: No validation occurs for this conditional required field.

h3. Issue 4

*Problem*: No error validation message is displayed if the user selects 費用負担 (Cost Allocation) as "その他 (Other)" but leaves 費用負担詳細 (Cost Allocation Details) empty. 
*Expected Behavior*: The system should display an error message: "Please enter the cost allocation details" (費用負担詳細を入力してください). 
*Actual Behavior*: No error message is displayed for the empty 費用負担詳細 field.

h3. Issue 5

*Problem*: When both conditions above are true and the user clicks 保存 (Save), nothing happens in the UI (no success or error message). 
*Expected Behavior*: The system should display validation errors and prevent form submission, or show an error message if submission fails. 
*Actual Behavior*: Upon checking developer tools, there is a 400 response from the API, but no feedback is shown to the user.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Login to the staging environment
# Navigate to the Transition Information Registration page at: [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/opportunity-detail/?opportunityId=af31b175-0c3f-4b6a-8011-53403c7af000&transitionWorkerId=016d3a3f-af26-4169-83ce-30695d39792d&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/opportunity-detail/?opportunityId=af31b175-0c3f-4b6a-8011-53403c7af000&transitionWorkerId=016d3a3f-af26-4169-83ce-30695d39792d&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem]
# In the Transition Cost (移行費用) section:
#* Enter a value in キャンセル料 (Cancellation Fee) field
#* Leave 決済額 (Payment Amount) field empty
#* Select "その他 (Other)" for 費用負担 (Cost Allocation)
#* Leave 費用負担詳細 (Cost Allocation Details) field empty
# Click 保存 (Save) button

h2. Expected Behavior

According to the [YME-10-04] Transition Information Registration use case:

# The system should validate that if キャンセル料 (Cancellation Fee) has a value, 決済額 (Payment Amount) should not be empty
# The system should display an error message: "Please enter the amount in half-width numbers" (金額は半角数字で入力してください)
# The system should validate that if 費用負担 (Cost Allocation) is "その他 (Other)", 費用負担詳細 (Cost Allocation Details) should not be empty
# The system should display an error message: "Please enter the cost allocation details" (費用負担詳細を入力してください)
# The system should display validation errors and prevent form submission, or show an error message if submission fails , UI displays the error toast message "Failed to register transition information." (移行情報の登録に失敗しました。)

*Expected Behavior*: The system should validate that if キャンセル料 has a value, 決済額 should not be empty. 
*Actual Behavior*: No validation occurs for this relationship between fields.

h3. Issue 2

*Problem*: No error validation message is displayed if the user enters a value in キャンセル料 (cancellation fee) but leaves 決済額 (payment amount) empty. 
*Expected Behavior*: The system should display an error message: "Please enter the amount in half-width numbers" (金額は半角数字で入力してください). 
*Actual Behavior*: No error message is displayed for the empty 決済額 field.

h3. Issue 3

*Problem*: If the user selects 費用負担 (Cost Allocation) as "その他 (Other)" but leaves 費用負担詳細 (Cost Allocation Details) empty. 
*Expected Behavior*: The system should validate that if 費用負担 is "その他", 費用負担詳細 should not be empty. 
*Actual Behavior*: No validation occurs for this conditional required field.

h3. Issue 4

*Problem*: No error validation message is displayed if the user selects 費用負担 (Cost Allocation) as "その他 (Other)" but leaves 費用負担詳細 (Cost Allocation Details) empty. 
*Expected Behavior*: The system should display an error message: "Please enter the cost allocation details" (費用負担詳細を入力してください). 
*Actual Behavior*: No error message is displayed for the empty 費用負担詳細 field.

h3. Issue 5

*Problem*: When both conditions above are true and the user clicks 保存 (Save), nothing happens in the UI (no success or error message). 
*Expected Behavior*: The system should display validation errors and prevent form submission, or show an error message if submission fails. 
*Actual Behavior*: Upon checking developer tools, there is a 400 response from the API, but no feedback is shown to the user.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Login to the staging environment
# Navigate to the Transition Information Registration page at: [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/opportunity-detail/?opportunityId=af31b175-0c3f-4b6a-8011-53403c7af000&transitionWorkerId=016d3a3f-af26-4169-83ce-30695d39792d&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/opportunity-detail/?opportunityId=af31b175-0c3f-4b6a-8011-53403c7af000&transitionWorkerId=016d3a3f-af26-4169-83ce-30695d39792d&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem]
# In the Transition Cost (移行費用) section:
#* Enter a value in キャンセル料 (Cancellation Fee) field
#* Leave 決済額 (Payment Amount) field empty
#* Select "その他 (Other)" for 費用負担 (Cost Allocation)
#* Leave 費用負担詳細 (Cost Allocation Details) field empty
# Click 保存 (Save) button

h2. Expected Behavior

According to the [YME-10-04] Transition Information Registration use case:

# The system should validate that if キャンセル料 (Cancellation Fee) has a value, 決済額 (Payment Amount) should not be empty
# The system should display an error message: "Please enter the amount in half-width numbers" (金額は半角数字で入力してください)
# The system should validate that if 費用負担 (Cost Allocation) is "その他 (Other)", 費用負担詳細 (Cost Allocation Details) should not be empty
# The system should display an error message: "Please enter the cost allocation details" (費用負担詳細を入力してください)
# The system should display validation errors and prevent form submission, or show an error message if submission fails , UI displays the error toast message "Failed to register transition information." (移行情報の登録に失敗しました。)

h2. Bug Description

When using Japanese input mode, users are able to input more than the specified character limit (100 characters) in certain input fields of the Transition Information Registration form. The validation is not properly enforcing the character limit for Japanese text input.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to the Transition Information Registration page using the URL above
# Select an input field that has a character limit (e.g., notes field)
# Switch to Japanese input mode
# Enter more than 100 Japanese characters
# Observe that the system accepts more than 100 characters without showing validation error

h2. Expected Behavior

The system should enforce the character limit of 100 characters (or 1000 characters where applicable) regardless of the input language. When the limit is exceeded, the validation error message should be displayed: "「XXX（項目名）」はXX（項目の最大文字数）文字以内で入力してください。" [Please enter "XXX (item name)" within XX characters.]

h2. Actual Behavior

The system allows users to input more than the specified character limit when using Japanese input mode. No validation error is displayed when the limit is exceeded.

h2. Summary

The date picker calendar overlaps with form elements when users scroll up or down while selecting dates for "出発日時" (Departure Date/Time) and "到着日時" (Arrival Date/Time) fields.

h2. Description

When a user opens the date picker calendar to select dates for either the departure or arrival fields, the calendar remains in a fixed position instead of scrolling with the page. This causes the calendar to overlap with other form elements when the user scrolls up or down, making both the calendar and the underlying form elements difficult to use.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to the travel/transportation form page
# Click on either "出発日時" (Departure Date/Time) or "到着日時" (Arrival Date/Time) field to open the date picker
# While the date picker is open, scroll up or down on the page
# Observe that the date picker remains in a fixed position and overlaps with other form elements

h2. Expected Behavior

The date picker should either:

# Move along with the page when scrolling (stay attached to its related input field), 
# Be positioned in a way that prevents overlap with other form elements regardless of scroll position

h2. Actual Behavior

The date picker remains in a fixed position on the screen when scrolling, causing it to overlap with other form elements. This makes both the date picker and the underlying form elements difficult to interact with.

h2. Visual Evidence

[https://www.loom.com/share/81fc543ef0b146b4947efd1bb58f21a5?sid=048b3538-ee5f-4d87-a3c4-a96170056eea|https://www.loom.com/share/81fc543ef0b146b4947efd1bb58f21a5?sid=048b3538-ee5f-4d87-a3c4-a96170056eea|smart-embed]

h2. Environment

h2. Bug Description

Users with permission level 0 (None) for Transition Management can still access the worker transition detail page. According to the system requirements, only users with View or Edit permissions should be able to access this page.

h2. Description

When a user first accesses the Migration Management / Local Worker page, the Migration Status (移行状況) filter shows "3" in the filter badge, indicating that 3 options are already selected. This contradicts the system specifications which state that no filters should be pre-selected when initially accessing the page. The error message displayed on the page states: "該当する移行情報が見つかりませんでした。フィルター条件を調整するか、条件を減らしてください。" (No matching transition information found. Please adjust the filter conditions or reduce the conditions.)

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Log in to the system
# Navigate to the Migration Management (移行管理) page 
# Click on the Local Worker (現地ワーカー) tab [https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/worker-detail/?staffId=43a378b1-ae66-4ab8-8df4-29691567f768&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/worker-detail/?staffId=43a378b1-ae66-4ab8-8df4-29691567f768&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem]
# Observe the Migration Status (移行状況) filter

h2. Expected Behavior

When first accessing the Migration Management / Local Worker page, no filters should be pre-selected. The Migration Status filter should show "0" or no badge, indicating no selections.

h2. Actual Behavior

The Migration Status (移行状況) filter shows "3" in the filter badge, indicating that 3 options are already pre-selected.

h2. Screenshots

!image-20250521-062115.png|width=2400,height=1199,alt="image-20250521-062115.png"!

* *URL*: [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/worker-detail/?staffId=43a378b1-ae66-4ab8-8df4-29691567f768&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/transition/worker-detail/?staffId=43a378b1-ae66-4ab8-8df4-29691567f768&transitionStatus=registration%2Cwaiting_transition%2Cproblem]

* *OS*: [Tester to specify]

h2. Summary

The breadcrumb in the transition worker detail page does not display the selected worker's name (e.g., "Eliza Berge") even though the name is visible in the page content.

h2. Description

When a user navigates to the worker detail page in the transition management section, the breadcrumb navigation should include the worker's name to provide proper context. Currently, the breadcrumb does not show the worker's name, making it difficult for users to understand which worker's details they are viewing. In the provided example, the worker name "Eliza Berge" is visible on the page (as shown in the screenshot), but this name is not reflected in the breadcrumb navigation.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to the Transition Management screen
# Select a worker (e.g., Eliza Berge) to view their details
# Observe the breadcrumb navigation at the top of the page

h2. Actual Result

The breadcrumb does not include the worker's name (Eliza Berge).

h2. Expected Result

The breadcrumb should include the worker's name (e.g., "移行管理 > 移行ワーカー > Eliza Berge") to provide proper context about which worker's details are being viewed.

items.fromString:
When copying and pasting text longer than 20 characters into the "Affiliated Organization" (company) field in the staff employment table, the field appears empty but still triggers validation errors.

h2. Environment

* *URL*: [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/staff/employment/+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/staff/employment/]
* *Browser*: [QA's browser information]
* *User Role*: Management Staff

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/staff/employment/+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/staff/employment/]
# Click on the filter button with the building icon (Affiliated Organization)
# Copy a text string longer than 20 characters
# Paste the text into the input field
# Observe the field behavior

h2. Current Behavior

* The field appears empty after pasting text longer than 20 characters
* Error validation message is displayed indicating character limit exceeded
* The filter is not applied, but the UI is in an inconsistent state

h2. Expected Behavior

* When pasting text longer than 20 characters, either:
** The text should be truncated to 20 characters and accepted, OR
** A clear error message should be shown and the field should display the attempted input

h2. Attachment



[https://www.loom.com/share/1fce3d7773b24f348bc7f0f14caf8c65?sid=a48170d4-fec3-4a81-ba2d-4e855db9b30c|https://www.loom.com/share/1fce3d7773b24f348bc7f0f14caf8c65?sid=a48170d4-fec3-4a81-ba2d-4e855db9b30c|smart-embed]

* Support updating information in different sections (tabs)
* Validate input data according to business rules
* Handle different staff roles and their specific editable fields
* Post relevant information to Salesforce as specified
* Maintain audit logs of changes 

*Acceptance Criteria:*
* API successfully updates staff information
* Input validation is properly implemented
* Updates are correctly saved to the database
* Relevant information is posted to Salesforce
* API handles partial updates for specific sections
* API includes proper error handling and validation feedback

h2. Description

When a user successfully resets their password and lands on the success page ({{/management/password-reset/success/}}), refreshing the page incorrectly redirects them to the invalid link error page ({{/management/password-reset/invalid-error/}}) instead of redirecting to the login page.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/password-reset/success/+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/password-reset/success/]
# Once on the success page, refresh the browser

h2. Current Behavior

Upon refreshing the success page, the user is redirected to {{/management/password-reset/invalid-error/}} which displays an error message stating that the link has expired or is invalid.

h2. Expected Behavior

When refreshing the success page, the user should be redirected to the login page ({{/management/login}}) as this would be the logical next step after a successful password reset.

h2. Attachment

items.toString:
h2. Description

When a user successfully resets their password and lands on the success page ({{/management/password-reset/success/}}), refreshing the page incorrectly redirects them to the invalid link error page ({{/management/password-reset/invalid-error/}}) instead of redirecting to the login page.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Navigate to [{color:#ffffff}+https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/password-reset/success/+{color}|https://staging.yuime-staffcore.com/management/password-reset/success/]
# Once on the success page, refresh the browser

h2. Current Behavior

Upon refreshing the success page, the user is redirected to {{/management/password-reset/invalid-error/}} which displays an error message stating that the link has expired or is invalid.

h2. Expected Behavior

When refreshing the success page, the user should be redirected to the login page ({{/management/login}}) as this would be the logical next step after a successful password reset.
